answer: Replay checks are what keep a log honest. Each seat keeps an island log, an append-only list of 80 signed receipts, 8 of which must be fable receipts: key-unique synthetic jobs that still have to be computed in full so the log cannot be padded with empty work. Each epoch a lantern seed names 4 receipts to rebuild from the original inputs in 12 minutes. A mismatched replay retires the seat. Each extra name therefore needs 80 genuine jobs first, then 4 rebuilds per epoch; 500 names require 2,000 rebuilds, caught or uncaught.
